description: This file implements the LaunchDelegate class for a Thunder plugin, handling app lifecycle operations via JSON-RPC endpoints, including launch, stop, configuration, and status reporting.

classes.name: LaunchDelegate
classes.description: A class implementing a Thunder plugin for app lifecycle management, providing JSON-RPC endpoints for launching, stopping, configuring, and querying app statuses.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service shell, loading configuration and setting initial state.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up the plugin, unregistering endpoints and clearing internal state.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns version information about the plugin.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all JSON-RPC endpoints.

methods.name: UnregisterAll
methods.description: Unregisters all JSON-RPC endpoints.

methods.name: endpoint_ping
methods.description: Responds with 'pong' to a ping request.

methods.name: endpoint_getInfo
methods.description: Returns plugin information including name, version, state, and timeouts.

methods.name: endpoint_configure
methods.description: Configures plugin settings such as enabled state, default delegate, and timeouts.

methods.name: endpoint_launch
methods.description: Handles app launch requests, firing events and updating status.

methods.name: endpoint_stop
methods.description: Handles app stop requests, firing events and updating status.

methods.name: endpoint_status
methods.description: Returns the current status of a specified app.

methods.name: event_statechanged
methods.description: Notifies listeners of a state change.

methods.name: event_launchrequested
methods.description: Fires an event indicating a launch request.

methods.name: event_launchcompleted
methods.description: Fires an event indicating a launch operation has completed.

methods.name: event_stoprequested
methods.description: Fires an event indicating a stop request.

methods.name: event_stopcompleted
methods.description: Fires an event indicating a stop operation has completed.

methods.name: GenerateRequestId
methods.description: Generates a unique request ID based on current time ticks.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the plugin is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: DelegateLaunch
methods.description: Placeholder method to delegate app launch to external system.

methods.name: DelegateStop
methods.description: Placeholder method to delegate app stop to external system.
